events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, the legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art began, bringing together hundreds of thousands for 'three days of peace and music'.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, the Woodstock Festival kicked off. What's your favourite memory or track from that iconic weekend?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering The King, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in '77. His music and influence are eternal.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar icon Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, the man who redefined the electric guitar, who left us too soon on this day in '70.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary is coming up! That album cover is one of the most famous of all time.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the iconic Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger to British music.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day, we reflect on John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine', the single for which was released in October 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: John Lennon's 'Imagine' is a song that still resonates today. What does its message mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod in October 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod's Impact
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped? It changed everything for music lovers. What was your first MP3 player?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite Bond film or moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' legendary co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend, John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary is coming up. So many incredible tracks on one album – which is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The world remembers the incredible Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Timeless Talent
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
